parameter_status: literature-informed clinical protection index; unidentified mappings and durations are explicit sensitivity assumptions
mumps_scale_definition: Initial response probability 0.964 (95% CI 0.940–0.978), not pooled follow-up effectiveness. Shared dose intercept and reset at latest dose are model assumptions.
mumps_tau_definition: Mean exponential protection duration 27.4 y (95% CI 16.7–51.1); sensitivity grid retains rounded 16/27/51 for legacy compatibility.
other_parameters: Measles .93/.97, rubella .95, pertussis .50/.85 with tau5 remain endpoint-specific clinical-index scenarios. Diphtheria .71/.87 are pooled partial/full clinical VE; tau30 is a structural reference evaluated at 10/30/100/infinite.
weight_definition: birth-cohort-size weights from the existing cohort input; survival and migration excluded
diphtheria_definition: Symptomatic VE 0.71 for pooled 1–2 doses and 0.87 for >=3 doses; DTP1 represents incomplete-series proxy. Thirty-year duration is an explicit review scenario, not antibody half-life or booster interval.
